data.one_liner: A tool to make development and distribution of flutter-pi apps easier.
data.what_it_does: A command-line tool that simplifies developing, building, running, and distributing Flutter apps for flutter-pi (embedded Linux). It integrates deeply with the official Flutter tool to handle device management, asset bundle generation, and running apps on remote target hardware.
use_when: You are developing Flutter applications for Raspberry Pi or other embedded Linux devices using flutter-pi.
You need to build flutter-pi asset bundles and run or test apps on remote attached devices.
avoid_when: You are building standard mobile, desktop, or web apps without embedded Linux targets.
You are using an incompatible Flutter SDK version and cannot adjust to the required flutterpi_tool version.
strengths: Simplifies device management and remote deployment for embedded Linux.
Supports meta-flutter yocto distros and custom display options.
Integrated deeply with the official Flutter tool commands.
weaknesses: Can encounter version incompatibility errors if not matched with the correct stable Flutter SDK.
Limited specifically to flutter-pi target environments.
data.setup_notes: Install globally via 'flutter pub global activate flutterpi_tool', ensuring your Flutter SDK version is compatible.
data.minimal_example:
flutter pub global activate flutterpi_tool
flutterpi_tool devices add pi@pi5
flutterpi_tool run -d pi5
